notes.title: Arken Age Update | Shield + Syringe Quick Grab | Guns Balancing
notes.content:
Hey Guys, we're back again with another update! The game is doing really well and we want to continually improve it while making changes that could work in a sequel as well. 

The biggest additions are the new Shield shoulder grab, Syringe grab from your chest, and buffs to all guns in order balance melee/ ranged combat damage. 

If you open your in-game tablet and go to Settings>VR Body, you can choose from three Syringe Modes, "Button Press (Default), Button Stab (Auto-Heal), & Chest Grab (new). Chest Grab mode allows you to physically grab a syringe from your chest instead of using a button press at all. In addition, we have added a Shield Mode setting, with options for "Button Press (Default)" and a new "Shoulder Grab" setting. This setting allows you to quickly grab a shield from over your Left Shoulder (or Right Shoulder if swapped with Heavy Gun). These two settings combined means that most of the combat in the game can be played without any button presses (other than for jumping & occasionally deploying grenades etc.) 

Another big change is the damage balancing of all ranged weapons. Changes have been applied to the Light Gun (Pistol) and Heavy Gun (Shotgun) plus all barrel mods at varying damage increases. This should increase the viability of full ranged/ gun-based combat in the game.  

In addition, we added an inverted controls option, climbing pick-sensitivity options, and some additional map icons, among many other new options (all in the patch notes below). Hope you guys enjoy the update! And it would be great to hear your thoughts on this new way to play Arken Age.

Cheers, Blake & the VitruviusVR Team

notes.title: Major Update to Arken Age | New Map System Added!
notes.content:
Hey Guys, hope you've been enjoying Arken Age over the past couple weeks! The launch has gone extremely well and it's been amazing to hear your thoughts on the game so far. We've been listening to your feedback everyday and I'm happy to share that we have finished the new Map System in the game! 

You can now open your main tablet and  select "Map" from the left hand display to bring up the full Bio-Chasm map. From here you can track main objectives, side quests, and machinery locations much like the Relic tracking works in the game. Our biggest worry was that the Map would deter exploration in the game, so we added 3 tiers of Objective "Hints" on the Map. 

Hints set as "Basic" will function exactly like the teleporter map works in the game currently, hints "Off" will remove all objectives, and hints "On" will have an arrow pointing at the next main story objective in the game. While hints are "On," you can also click on side objectives on the map to track, instead of proceeding with the main story. Once side objectives are completed or cancelled the map will point you along the main path once again. 

In addition, in Map "Settings" you can turn on Buy Stations, Crafting Tables, Health Stations, Teleporters, and Refinery locations that you have previously been to, in order to backtrack easily to those locations. Hope you guys enjoy the update! 

[i]Cheers, Blake  & the VitruviusVR Team[/i]

notes.title: Arken Age is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey Guys, It's Blake Stone here from VitruviusVR,  I just wanted to start off by saying thanks to everyone in the VR community for their support over the years. Without your support of "Mervils" when we first started developing for VR there never would have been "Shadow Legend," and without your overwhelming support of Shadow Legend we would have never been able to make Arken Age into the game it is today. Launch Trailer below:

[previewyoutube=rflTHH0o_Ws;full][/previewyoutube]

For those unfamiliar with Arken Age, the game is a single-player sci-fi fantasy adventure with an over 15 hour campaign. The game is set in the Bio-Chasm—a terraformed fantasy world created by the Grand Arborist. In the game you can engage in full physics combat using Arkenite infused swords & guns—and freely explore the densely filled environments under siege by Hyperion's neural corruption.

Arken Age is a full fledged VR adventure with climbing, swimming, weapon customization, crafting, physics based combat, and an engaging story. In the game you will uncover the truth behind the disappearance of the Grand Arborist, forge an alliance with the Nara alien race, and take up arms against the usurper Hyperion & his legion of corrupted soldiers.

Really hope you guys enjoy the game!

-Blake & the VitruviusVR Team
